name: Holiday
description: Holiday and winter-ball cheer: evergreen and cranberry, gold, candy-cane stripes, hanging ornaments, gift-tag lower thirds and falling snow. A Season's Greetings card and a transparent Snowfall overlay you can lay over any shot. Every graphic type, plus basketball, football and hockey.
